candidates.snippet: 1903: Founding of Ford Motor Company - Founded the Ford Motor Company, which would pioneer mass production techniques. 1908: Introduction of the Model T - Introduced the Model T, the first affordable automobile for the masses. 1914: Implementation of the Five-Dollar Day - Instituted the five-dollar workday, significantly raising wages for factory workers. 1922: Publication of 'My Life and Work' - Published his influential autobiography and business philosophy, 'My Life and Work'.
